info.name: EC2 Image Builder CancelImageCreation CreateImage API
info.description:
EC2 Image Builder is a fully managed Amazon Web Services service that makes it easier to automate the creation, management, and deployment of customized, secure, and up-to-date "golden" server images that are pre-installed and pre-configured with software and settings to meet specific IT standards.

Contact Support:
 Name: Mike Ralphson
 Email: mike.ralphson@gmail.com

item.name: Amazon EC2 Image Builder Create Image

request.description: Creates a new image. This request will create a new image along with all of the configured output resources defined in the distribution configuration. You must specify exactly one recipe for your image, using either a ContainerRecipeArn or an ImageRecipeArn.
